author: Nick Caverson
html: Although I am a Google lover I was never so aware of why as I am now that you have pointed out the quietly hidden reasons why I love them. Very few of their services that I have for have ever disappointed me and even as a person that is somewhat computer/internet savvy I am often out loud suprised. Thanks for the stimulating article.

author: Bob Taylor
html:
This should be required reading for every web designer. Especially the top 3. Too many websites seem to forget that there are real people looking at them and that time is precious. Despite the hundreds of articles on the net that tell designers to make simple, fast loading website, we still get sites with huge graphics that take forever to load.

Thanks for posting it.

author: ilyas
html: Thats worth a read for sure, thanks for a good article. I love the "Every millisecond counts" and "Delight the eye without distracting the mind.". Google do apply all these and many more to there stuffs.
